question.problem:
Given the joint probability distribution for two discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ below, find $\text{E}[Y].$

| $f$ | $Y=-1$ | $Y=0$ | $Y=1$ | $Y=2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $0.1$ | $0.15$ | $0.15$ | $0.1$ |
| $X=1$ | $0.1$ | $0.15$ | $0.1$ | $0.15$ |
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the marginal distribution for $X$ corresponds to the row totals, and the marginal distribution for $Y$ corresponds to the column totals.

| $f(x,y)$ | $Y=-1$ | $Y=0$ | $Y=1$ | $Y=2$ | ${f}_{X}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $0.1$ | $0.15$ | $0.15$ | $0.1$ | $…$ |
| $X=1$ | $0.1$ | $0.15$ | $0.1$ | $0.15$ | $…$ |
| ${f}_{Y}$ | $0.2$ | $0.3$ | $0.25$ | $0.25$ | $1$ |

Therefore, the probability mass function for  $Y$ is given by the following table:

| $y$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{Y}(y)$ | $0.2$ | $0.3$ | $0.25$ | $0.25$ |

Finally, the  expected value of $Y$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[Y] & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{y}_{i}\,{f}_{Y}({y}_{i}) \\  & =(-1)\cdot 0.2+0\cdot 0.3+1\cdot 0.25+2\cdot 0.25 \\  & =-0.2+0+0.25+0.5 \\  & =0.55.\end{aligned}
$$
